blocks.raw: <Tip>Memorize ASTM C920 Classes by movement: 100/50 (maximum), 50 (standard), 25 (light), 12.5 (minimal). Joint design rule: width ÷ 2 = depth. Backer rod = 1.25-1.5× joint width. Silicone = UV/temp stable, poor adhesion. Polyurethane = adhesive, rapid cure, moisture-tolerant. Tropical = polysulfide for fuel/salt.</Tip>
